overview: Mawgan Porth Apartments is a small block of four self-catering apartments around 300m from the beach at Mawgan Porth. There is one one-bedroom and three two-bedroom units, each sleeping four plus an infant, with full kitchens, Wi-Fi and laundry facilities. Each apartment has a reserved parking space, and cafés and a shop are near the beach.
